description: This file defines a singly linked list implementation in Kotlin, including basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get, along with an internal Node class.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A class implementing a linked list data structure with methods to add, remove, get size, and retrieve elements at a specific index.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, containing data and a reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element at the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Removes a node from the list by updating references, used internally.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: A companion object method determining the last node in the list.
